---
title: "00_setup.R"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# 00_setup.R
#
# Project: qFL-Chr.25 End-Use Evaluation
#
# Purpose:
#   1. Load packages used throughout the project
#   2. Define project folder paths
#   3. Create required output folders
#   4. Set global analysis options
#
# Important:
#   Open the project using End-Use-Evaluation.Rproj before running scripts.
# ==========================================================================


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Confirm that the R project is open from the correct folder
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

project_file <- "End-Use-Evaluation.Rproj"

if (!file.exists(project_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "\nThe R project root was not detected.\n\n",
      "Open the project by double-clicking:\n",
      "End-Use-Evaluation.Rproj\n\n",
      "The working directory should be the main 'End-Use Evaluation' folder."
    )
  )
}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "readxl",
  "janitor",
  "here",
  "lme4",
  "lmerTest",
  "emmeans",
  "broom.mixed",
  "performance",
  "patchwork",
  "knitr",
  "rmarkdown"
)


# Identify packages that have not been installed
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    quietly = TRUE,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
]


# Do not install packages automatically inside the analysis pipeline.
# Instead, stop and show the command needed.
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "\nThe following packages are not installed:\n\n",
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
      "\n\nInstall them using:\n\n",
      'install.packages(c("',
      paste(missing_packages, collapse = '", "'),
      '"))\n'
    )
  )
}


# Load packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
  library(here)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)
  library(emmeans)
  library(broom.mixed)
  library(performance)
  library(patchwork)
  library(knitr)
  library(rmarkdown)
})


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define project paths
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

paths <- list(
  manuscript          = here("01_manuscript"),
  data_raw            = here("02_data_raw"),
  data_processed      = here("03_data_processed"),
  code                = here("04_code"),
  results             = here("05_results"),
  submission          = here("06_submission"),

  audit               = here("05_results", "audit"),
  afis_results        = here("05_results", "AFIS"),
  yarn_results        = here("05_results", "yarn"),
  figures             = here("05_results", "figures"),
  tables              = here("05_results", "tables"),
  notebook_outputs    = here("05_results", "notebook_outputs")
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create output folders if they do not exist
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

folders_to_create <- unname(unlist(paths))

purrr::walk(
  folders_to_create,
  ~ dir.create(
    path = .x,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Global options
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

options(
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE,
  scipen = 999,
  contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly")
)


# Keep character columns as character
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# Set emmeans options
emmeans::emm_options(
  lmer.df = "kenward-roger"
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Helper functions
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Clean identifiers while retaining meaningful letters and numbers
clean_identifier <- function(x) {
  x |>
    as.character() |>
    stringr::str_trim() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("\\s+", "") |>
    dplyr::na_if("")
}


# Convert a value safely to numeric
safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  readr::parse_number(as.character(x))
}


# Standardize genotype names
standardize_genotype <- function(x) {

  cleaned <- x |>
    as.character() |>
    stringr::str_trim() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("[[:space:]_-]+", "") |>
    stringr::str_to_upper()

  dplyr::recode(
    cleaned,

    "AC107NEG" = "AC107Neg",
    "AC107POS" = "AC107Pos",
    "AC164NEG" = "AC164Neg",
    "AC164POS" = "AC164Pos",
    "ACSJ4" = "ACSJ4",

    "DP213NEG" = "DP213Neg",
    "DP213POS" = "DP213Pos",
    "DP263NEG" = "DP263Neg",
    "DP263POS" = "DP263Pos",
    "DP50" = "DP50",

    "GA428NEG" = "GA428Neg",
    "GA428POS" = "GA428Pos",
    "GA437NEG" = "GA437Neg",
    "GA437POS" = "GA437Pos",
    "GA089" = "GA089",

    "PM304NEG" = "PM304Neg",
    "PM304POS" = "PM304Pos",
    "PM321NEG" = "PM321Neg",
    "PM321POS" = "PM321Pos",
    "PMHS26" = "PMHS26",

    "SEALAND883" = "SL883",
    "SL883" = "SL883",

    "GA201800" = "GA201800",
    "GA201808" = "GA201808",

    .default = NA_character_
  )
}


# Standardize processing-stage names
standardize_stage <- function(x) {

  cleaned <- x |>
    as.character() |>
    stringr::str_trim() |>
    stringr::str_to_lower() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", " ") |>
    stringr::str_squish()

  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(cleaned, "bale") ~ "Bale",

    stringr::str_detect(
      cleaned,
      "open|opener"
    ) ~ "Opened",

    stringr::str_detect(
      cleaned,
      "card"
    ) ~ "Carded",

    stringr::str_detect(
      cleaned,
      "sliver"
    ) ~ "Sliver",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}


# Stop with a clear message when a file is missing
check_file_exists <- function(file_path) {

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "\nRequired file was not found:\n",
        file_path,
        "\n\nCheck the filename and location in 02_data_raw."
      )
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}


# Display available Excel sheets
show_excel_sheets <- function(file_path) {

  check_file_exists(file_path)

  message("\nWorkbook: ", basename(file_path))
  print(readxl::excel_sheets(file_path))

  invisible(readxl::excel_sheets(file_path))
}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Genotype classification key
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

genotype_key <- tibble::tribble(
  ~genotype,   ~background, ~nil_set, ~qtl_status,    ~material_type,

  "AC107Neg",  "Acala",     "AC107",   "Negative",     "NIIL",
  "AC107Pos",  "Acala",     "AC107",   "Positive",     "NIIL",
  "AC164Neg",  "Acala",     "AC164",   "Negative",     "NIIL",
  "AC164Pos",  "Acala",     "AC164",   "Positive",     "NIIL",
  "ACSJ4",     "Acala",     NA,        "Parent_Check", "Recurrent parent",

  "DP213Neg",  "Deltapine", "DP213",   "Negative",     "NIIL",
  "DP213Pos",  "Deltapine", "DP213",   "Positive",     "NIIL",
  "DP263Neg",  "Deltapine", "DP263",   "Negative",     "NIIL",
  "DP263Pos",  "Deltapine", "DP263",   "Positive",     "NIIL",
  "DP50",      "Deltapine", NA,        "Parent_Check", "Recurrent parent",

  "GA428Neg",  "Georgia",   "GA428",   "Negative",     "NIIL",
  "GA428Pos",  "Georgia",   "GA428",   "Positive",     "NIIL",
  "GA437Neg",  "Georgia",   "GA437",   "Negative",     "NIIL",
  "GA437Pos",  "Georgia",   "GA437",   "Positive",     "NIIL",
  "GA089",     "Georgia",   NA,        "Parent_Check", "Recurrent parent",

  "PM304Neg",  "Paymaster", "PM304",   "Negative",     "NIIL",
  "PM304Pos",  "Paymaster", "PM304",   "Positive",     "NIIL",
  "PM321Neg",  "Paymaster", "PM321",   "Negative",     "NIIL",
  "PM321Pos",  "Paymaster", "PM321",   "Positive",     "NIIL",
  "PMHS26",    "Paymaster", NA,        "Parent_Check", "Recurrent parent",

  "SL883",     "Donor",     NA,        "Parent_Check", "QTL donor",
  "GA201800",  "Check",     NA,        "Parent_Check", "Check",
  "GA201808",  "Check",     NA,        "Parent_Check", "Check"
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save the genotype key
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  genotype_key,
  here("03_data_processed", "genotype_key.csv"),
  na = ""
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Setup confirmation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "\nSetup completed successfully.",
  "\nProject root: ", here(),
  "\nProcessed data folder: ", paths$data_processed,
  "\nResults folder: ", paths$results,
  "\nNotebook output folder: ", paths$notebook_outputs,
  "\n"
)
```
